verdicts.reason: The generated API test job runs the unconditional Chromium integration test without installing its pinned browser or supplying an executable override; installation occurs only in the separate e2e job.

The generated Next browser job supplies only E2E_MODE before next build, whose configuration imports the required NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL validator; the generated .env is ignored and absent from a clean checkout.
The exported reset request omits password_confirmation, but the configured ResetPasswordAction requires confirmed validation.
Both passkey screens permit enrollment during the initial GET and independently commit initial and post-registration responses, allowing a delayed initial result to overwrite the refreshed list.
Both recovery screens retain displayed codes until the replacement GET succeeds, although the successful POST has already invalidated those codes.
Inertia's synchronous reset notification can throw before either response binding runs, producing an error for an existing account while an absent account receives the generic response.
